message.content:
Long-line wool-blend trench coat in earthy olive with Hex #556B2F, tailored fit with belted waist and dropped shoulders, heavy woven fabric.
Slim-fit dark denim trouser in deep indigo with Hex #191A38, straight leg cut with a subtle high rise, sturdy cotton twill material.
Structured navy wool-blazer with notched lapels and single-button closure, classic fit with slight taper at the waist, fine herringbone weave fabric.
Silk-shell blouse in champagne gold with Hex #F5E6CA, relaxed collar and three-quarter sleeves gathered at the cuff, smooth liquid fabric.
Low-block suede ankle booties in cognac brown with Hex #8B4513, round toe and stacked heel height of about seven centimeters, supple leather material.
This ensemble balances your request for a neat yet formal look suitable for an autumn evening date by combining the sophistication of a blazer and trench coat with the comfort of dark denim. The earthy olive and cognac tones harmonize beautifully with the indigo trousers and champagne blouse, creating a warm palette perfect for rainy weather while maintaining elegance. The chosen fabrics offer both structure and fluidity, ensuring you feel confident and stylish whether sitting by the fire or stepping out into the cool air.
